content: Depit Kapitala Kahnimw Keila
Depit rongada me mehn Pilisdia kan mahmahweniong kahnimw Keila oh piripirapasang wahn kohn kan me re ahpwtehn kihpene.
Ih eri kalelapak rehn KAUN-O, patohwan, “Maing, I en patohla mahweniong mehn Pilisdia kan?” KAUN-O ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ei, mahweniong irail oh kapitala kahnimw Keila.”
Sapwellimen Depit sounpei ko ahpw patohwanohng, “Komw mahsanih duwen at masepwehk wasaht nan Suda; e pahn ukla at masepwehk ma se pahn kohla mahweniong karis en Pilisdia kan!”
Depit eri pwurehng kalelapak rehn KAUN-O, KAUN-O ahpw ketin mahsanihong, “Kohwei oh mahweniong Keila, pwehki I pahn ketikihong uhk pwe ke en powehdi mehn Pilisdia kan.”
Depit oh sapwellime sounpei ko ahpw ketlahng Keila, oh mahweniong mehn Pilisdia kan, re ahpw kemehla me ngeder rehrail oh wahsang neirail pelinmen kan. Ih duwen eh kapitala kahnimw Keila.
Apaiadar nein Ahimelek wahsang ihpod ni ahnsou me e tangdoaui oh iangala Depit nan Keila.

Re ahpw patohwanohng Sohl me Depit patolahngehr Keila; e ahpw mahsanih, “Koht ketikidier Depit pahn ei manaman. Depit pedolongehr nan lidip ehu me iei kahnimw me mie kehl kapilpene iangahki wenihmw kehlail kei.”
Sohl eri kapokonepene sapwellime sounpei kan pwe re en mahwen, re en kolahng kahnimw Keila oh koledi Depit oh nah sounpei ko.
Ahnsou me Depit rongada me Sohl koasoakoasoane en mahweniong, e patohwanohng samworo Apaiadar, “Komw patohwando ihpodo met.”
Depit ahpw patohwanohng KAUN-O, “Maing KAUN, Koht en Israel, I rongehr me Sohl koasoakoasoane en patohdo Keila oh kamwomwala pwehki ngehi, sapwellimomwi ladu.

Ia duwe, pwilidak en Keila kan pahn pangielahng rehn Sohl? Sohl uhdahn pahn patohdo, duwen me I rongehr? Maing KAUN, Koht en Israel, I patohwan peki komwi en ketin sapeng ie.” KAUN-O ahpw ketin sapeng mahsanih, “Sohl pahn patohdo.”
A Depit pwurehng patohwan, “A pwilidak en Keila kan pahn pangalahng Sohl ngehi oh nei sounpei kan?” KAUN-O ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Re pahn pangkumwailla.”
Eri, Depit oh nah sounpei ko—koaros patpene kerenieng limepwiki—mwadangete kohkohla sang Keila. Ni Sohl eh rongada me Depit tangasangehr Keila, e ahpw kapweiekidi kupwure.
Depit nan Sahpw Nahnahn
Depit wie rukurukselihte nan sahpw nahnahno, nan sapwtehn limwahn Sip. Sohl ahpw kin songosong raparapahki, ahpw Koht sohte ketin mweidohng en diar.
Depit esehte me Sohl raparapahki pwehn kemehla. Depit mihmihte Ores, nan sapwtehn limwahn Sip.
Sonadan ahpw kohla reh oh koangngoangehki ndindaiong duwen eh Koht eh ketin sinsile.
E patohwanohng Depit, ketihtihki, “Komw dehr masak mehkot. Ei pahpa Sohl sohte kak en kauweikomwihla. E ese mehlel me komwi me pahn wiahla nanmwarkien Israel oh ngehi me pahn keriaun kaun.”
Ira riemeno ahpw wiahda inou sarawi ehu nanpwungara me ira pahn wiahla pirien ehu. Depit eri mihmihte Ores, a Sonadan pwurala ni imweo.
Aramas ekei sang Sip ahpw kohla rehn Sohl nan Kipea oh patohwanohng, “Depit wie rukurukseli nan sapwatail nan Ores nin Nahna Akila, ni palieir en sapwtehn en Suda.
Se patohwan ese, maing, Wasa Lapalap, uwen omwi kupwurki saikedi; eri komwi ketido nan sapwatet, se ahpw pahn sewesei komwi saikedi.”
Sohl ahpw sapeng irail, mahsanih, “KAUN-O en ketin kupwuramwahwih kumwail pwehki amwail ngoang oh kadek ong ie.
Kumwail pwurowei oh pwurehng tehk mwahu wasa e kin mihmi ie oh ihs me kilang ih wasao. I rong me e inenen kadek widing.

Kumwail rapahkihda wasa kan me e kin rukuruk ie, oh kumwail mwadang pakairkihong ie. I ahpw pahn iang kumwail kohwei, oh ma e mihmihte wasao, I pahn salihedi, mehnda ma I pahn kohkohseli raparapahki nan Suda pwon.”
Irail eri mwesel oh pwurala nan Sip mwohn Sohl. Depit oh nah sounpei ko mihmi nan sapwtehn en Maon, nan wahu tehn ehu ni palieir en sapwtehn en Suda.

Sohl oh sapwellime sounpei ko eri mwesel pwe re en rapahki Depit, ahpw Depit rongada duwen mwekid wet, ih eri tangala nan wasa takain sapwtehn en Maon oh mihmi mwo. Ni Sohl eh rongada met, e ahpw pwakihala Depit.
Sohl oh sapwellime sounpei ko ket ni apali dohlo, a Depit oh nah ko apali. Depit karkaruaru en tangasang Sohl oh sapwellime ko me songosong en kapilirailpene oh nektehn koliraildi.
Ni ahnsowohte meninkeder kei pa leledo rehn Sohl oh patohwanohng, “Komw mwadang ketido, pwe mehn Pilisdia kan nektehn mahweniong nin limomwio.”
Sohl eri tokedi sang pwakipwakih Depit, e ahpw ketila mahweniong mehn Pilisdia ko. Ih kahrepen wasao eh adanekihla Dohlen Tohrohrpeseng.
Depit eri mwesel oh kohla nan sapwen Engkedi, wasa e patopato ie ni rir.
